name: KAAN ALPER
tagline: I build the tools my own machine is missing:
Linux desktops, DPI bypass, native Rust apps.
typing: I beat DPI with a tray icon.
I write native Rust apps. No Electron.
I take games apart to see how they tick.

rows: desktop shells, censorship bypass, RE tools

featured.text: The Hyprland experience on Windows 10/11: its own tiling window manager, bar, panels and live wallpapers.

featured.text: Your Aegis 2FA vault, native on the Linux desktop. Pure Rust, Wayland and X11, no Electron, no cloud.
Reverse-engineering and modding studio: APK / IL2CPP patching, disassembly, Yara, live memory editing.
HTTPS-disguised MASQUE tunnel that survives Turkish DPI. Tray app for Windows and Linux plus a native Android app.
